TEXT-ONLY BRIEF (no reference images are attached): the look is classic chunky retro pixel art for the enemy sprites of a modern retro first-person horde shooter set on a cold moonlit night: bold, instantly readable silhouettes with big heads and expressive faces; every material shaded with 2 to 3 flat tones (a lighter tone on the upper front, a mid tone, a dark shadow tone), lit softly from the upper front; small clusters of darker pixels as texture on skin, cloth and wood; thin dark interior lines for folds, muscles and planks; a muted, slightly desaturated palette (olive, ochre-grey, dull brown, slate, dull iron) in which only fire and glowing eyes are bright. Everything below is an original design.

STYLE: a 2D PIXEL-ART SPRITE SHEET for a video game. True low-resolution pixel art: each figure is about 44 art pixels tall and every art pixel is a crisp square block of the same size, hard edges, NO anti-aliasing, NO gradients, NO soft airbrush shading, NO blur, NO noise texture; a limited muted palette (about 12 to 16 flat colours for the character); a clean 1 to 2 art-pixel near-black outline (#1a1418) around every figure. All figures face the viewer (front view, toward the camera, like enemies charging at the player), drawn at the same scale in every frame, feet on a common baseline within each row.
BACKGROUND: one flat, perfectly uniform, solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere behind and between the figures. No ground, no floor line, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no numbers, no frame borders, no grid lines.

THE CHARACTER, GRUNT GOBLIN: a small hunched goblin foot soldier with an oversized round head, two long pointy ears sticking out sideways, olive-green skin (#6f7a3a), small pale yellow eyes, a wide mouth with two little lower tusks, a ragged brown-grey sackcloth tunic with a rope belt and a torn hem, skinny bare legs and big bare feet, holding a crude knobbly wooden club studded with one iron nail in its right hand (on the left side of the picture, since it faces the viewer). Muted colours: olive, ochre-grey, dull brown.

LAYOUT: exactly 11 figures of the SAME character, in 3 horizontal rows, read left to right:
Row 1 (top, 4 figures) WALK CYCLE: (1) left foot forward; (2) feet passing, body slightly higher; (3) right foot forward; (4) feet passing, body slightly higher.
Row 2 (middle, 4 figures): (5) ATTACK windup: the club raised high over its head with both hands, mouth open; (6) ATTACK strike: the club swung down in front, body leaning forward; (7) BURNING: the character is ON FIRE, orange-yellow pixel flames licking up from its head, shoulders and back, arms flailing up, mouth wide open screaming, its body lit orange; (8) BURNING: running in panic in a different flailing pose, flames on its back and head.
Row 3 (bottom, 3 figures) DEATH: (9) hit, recoiling backward, eyes squeezed shut; (10) knees buckling, falling, weapon dropping; (11) collapsed, lying flat on the ground as a low heap seen from the front.
Every figure stands alone with wide magenta gaps to every other figure; nothing touches or overlaps; each weapon stays inside its own figure's space.
